summary: Hood River County, OR lookout: cupola house from 1916 or 1923, burned 1932, L-4 cab 1933 or 1936, removed by 1965-67; foundation remnants and a summit register remain.

facts.design: D-6 cupola house (1923 per Forest Lookouts), later a 14x14 L-4 early model cabin
facts.status_note: Removed in the 1960s; a few remnants of the old lookout foundation and a summit register remain (Oregon Hikers)

access.note: Oregon Hikers lists a moderate loop hike that reaches the summit; the sources read describe no closure

visit.trail_note: Oregon Hikers lists an 11.5-mile loop with 2,640 ft of gain that reaches the summit

events.note: Register and Oregon Hikers date the first cupola cabin to 1916; Forest Lookouts starts its account in 1923
Nita Vogel and Ivy Gray living in a summit lookout house, per a 1918 newspaper quoted by Forest Lookouts
D-6 lookout house destroyed in a fire caused by a burning flue
Fire about one mile southwest of the top of Larch Mountain first reported by Lookout Waldron from the summit station
Station burned to the ground, per a Morning Oregonian report dated September 27, 1932
Cupola replaced with an L-4 cab (register and Oregon Hikers); Forest Lookouts gives 1936
Forest Lookouts: old cupola replaced by a 14x14 L-4 early model cabin
Register and Forest Fire Lookout Association: gone by 1965

resolved_conflicts.field: events: first lookout and its replacement
resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Oregon Hikers give a cupola cabin in 1916 and a replacement in 1933; Forest Lookouts starts with a D-6 house in 1923 and gives a 14x14 L-4 cabin in 1936. The story reports both and does not choose one.
Register and Forest Fire Lookout Association say gone by 1965; Forest Lookouts says removed around 1967; Oregon Hikers ties it to the mid-1960s demolition. The story gives the range.

notes_for_editor: No source gives a height, so height_m is omitted; the brief has none. The brief's FFLOS registration date (August 26, 2010) does not appear in the fetched register text, so no fflos_registered event was added. Access changed from unknown to public on the strength of the Oregon Hikers loop listing; no official Forest Service access record was read. Staffing after 1925 is not in the sources. Photos not added: the page text carries no image URLs.
